title: Deeper/broader cross-codec issue freshness and associative-layout evidence eligibility audit
mode: Primary-source issue, documentation, and local-code reconciliation
scope: Refresh selected LibreDWG issue reports and linked fixes, and reconcile them with existing generated local controls.
Reassess ACadRust issue #135's proposed AcDbAssocGeomDependency layout against the actual local ODA v5.4.1 PDF and current bounded parser path.
Check what ACadSharp and dwg-rs capability disclosures establish about operation- and version-specific parity.
Refine evidence eligibility and implementation readiness without creating duplicate findings, fixtures, dependencies, or recurring validation cost.

local_source_files_inspected: src/drw_objects.cpp: DRW_AssociativeObject::parseDwg bounded ACDBASSOCGEOMDEPENDENCY prefix path
src/drw_entities.cpp: DRW_Attrib embedded-MTEXT group-101 scope handling
tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp: HATCH/attribute, text framing, NOD ordering, and generated color controls
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing issue owners, evidence boundaries, and deferred external items
local_checks: Refreshed LibreDWG issues #1410, #1412, #1413, and #1415 and the linked #1412 commits; matched each reported shape to the existing HATCH/attribute, explicit-length sink, positional NOD, and CMC color owners.

Checked local generated controls for explicit-zero HATCH coordinates, unusual ATTDEF tags, embedded-MTEXT scoping/refusal, lower-handle owned dictionary versus positional NOD, and distinct C3 ACI/C2 RGB handling.
Inspected ACadRust issue #135 and confirmed its persistent-subentity byte-layout explanation is explicitly a hypothesis and its drawing is not public.

Located the ODA v5.4.1 PDF at /Users/dli/doc/dwg/OpenDesign_Specification_for_.dwg_files (1).pdf and searched extracted text for AcDbAssocGeomDependency, AssocGeomDependency, and persistent-subentity terms; no class-specific grammar was found. The sole generic Associative hit is the unrelated HATCH associative flag in section 20.4.75.
Compared the local bounded associative-object parser prefix with the peer hypothesis; the existing prefix/status behavior does not establish the remaining class-specific grammar.
Refreshed ACadSharp's compatibility matrix and dwg-rs README; retained version, direction, typed-decoding, and corpus boundaries instead of promoting generic support labels.
Updated the plan with a corrected evidence prerequisite and bounded implementation-readiness decisions; no production/test code, fixture, dependency, or support-claim change was made.
method.limitations: Issue reports and mutable peer repositories are route- and revision-specific, not normative format specifications or local reproductions. LibreDWG issue shapes do not establish a libdxfrw defect. ACadRust #135 provides no public DWG and labels its proposed persistent-subentity layout as a hypothesis. The local ODA v5.4.1 text contains no class-specific AcDbAssocGeomDependency grammar, so this document cannot resolve that layout. No peer runtime, external artifact, or native consumer qualification was performed; this pass is research-only.

sources.project: LibreDWG issue #1410 and Autodesk HATCH/MTEXT DXF references
sources.observed: The open peer report combines explicit-zero HATCH endpoint Y, hash-bearing ATTDEF tags, and embedded-MTEXT field handling. Its own proposed broad field skip is described as a stopgap; Autodesk's field references remain the relevant public DXF contract.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer writer/parser issue shapes only; matching generated local cases already exist, and no libdxfrw defect or new feature requirement was demonstrated.

sources.observed: The report describes a C string helper reading beyond its logical text due to NUL termination assumptions and a zero-length transformed-value framing case. Linked fixes are visible in mutable master but do not prove inclusion in a released artifact.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer-specific C implementation issue; the local writer uses explicit lengths, so the peer mechanism is not transferred as a local defect.

sources.project: LibreDWG issue #1413, Autodesk OBJECTS ordering reference, and local writer
sources.observed: The issue distinguishes the positional Named Objects Dictionary from a lower-handle owned extension dictionary. The local writer already emits the generated root dictionary first, and generated ASCII/Binary tests exercise the lower-handle case.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer report is not a local reproduction; existing local ordering and identity controls are reused without support promotion.

sources.project: LibreDWG issue #1415 and local CMC/HATCH color coverage
sources.observed: The corrected report separates C3 indexed ACI from C2 true RGB. Local generated cases retain packed C3 ACI independently from exact C2 RGB, including existing LAYER and HATCH routes.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Peer report is not a color-appearance oracle; raw method, ACI, true RGB, and native rendering remain distinct evidence.

sources.project: ACadRust issue #135 and local ODA v5.4.1 specification copy
sources.observed: The peer report describes AC1024 AcDbAssocGeomDependency failures and proposes a persistent-subentity layout as a hypothesis; no drawing is public. Search of the local ODA v5.4.1 extracted text found no class-specific AcDbAssocGeomDependency or persistent-subentity grammar. A generic HATCH associative flag mention is unrelated.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Neither the issue nor this ODA PDF establishes the disputed byte sequence. Require a version-pinned producer trace/sample or another primary source that actually specifies those bytes before changing parser grammar.

sources.project: ACadSharp compatibility matrix and dwg-rs README
sources.observed: ACadSharp's matrix includes operation-specific limits such as unavailable AC1021 DWG writing; dwg-rs labels itself pre-alpha and separates container/object enumeration from partial typed decoding with corpus-dependent counts.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Generic compatibility labels and corpus counts do not prove full semantic preservation or external writer acceptance.
